title: Best Laptops by Budget: Under $500, $600 & $1,000 (2026)
summary: 5 tested laptops you can find for under $1,000: a Mac, a Windows all-rounder, a gaming laptop, a Chromebook and a cheap Copilot+ PC.
method: Picks come from PCWorld's hands-on laptop testing (updated Oct 2026), plus the Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3x from the 2026 reviews we summarize in our Black Friday guide. Specs and battery figures are for the configuration PCWorld tested; Amazon listings can differ, so check the exact configuration before buying. We don't show prices because they change daily, and some of these only dip under $1,000 at certain stores or during sales.
assumptions: "under $1,000" is based on the lowest prices reported in Oct 2026; list prices and some retailers (including Amazon at times) can be higher.

products.name: Apple MacBook Neo
why: The MacBook Neo is PCWorld's pick for best budget laptop, and it is the cheapest MacBook Apple has made. It runs an A18 Pro chip with 8GB of memory and a 256GB SSD, which is plenty for browsing, email, streaming, documents and spreadsheets.

It does not feel cheap: the all-aluminum body is sturdy and the 13-inch screen is sharp and bright. The trade-offs are an sRGB-only display, a slow second USB-C port and no Thunderbolt, and Touch ID is only on the pricier model.
cons: Two USB-C ports with different speeds
No P3 color support, so not for serious color work
Touch ID only on the higher-priced model
products.best_for: Anyone who wants a Mac for everyday work and school without a Mac price.
products.skip_if: you need lots of memory, heavy video editing power, or accurate color.
products.amazon_listing: Apple 2026 MacBook Neo 13-inch Laptop with A18 Pro chip: Built for AI and Apple Intelligen
products.desc: A 13-inch MacBook with an A18 Pro chip, 8GB of memory and a 256GB SSD. It does not support P3 color, so it is not for serious color work.
products.benefit: Picture a student writing essays and streaming between classes on a sturdy aluminum laptop that lasts about 13 hours. PCWorld picks it as its best budget laptop, and it is the lightest PCWorld-tested pick in this guide at 2.7 lb. It gives you a Mac without a Mac price. The catch: multi-core performance lags and memory is 8GB.

products.name: Acer Swift 16 AI (Lunar Lake)
why: The Swift 16 AI gives you a big, sharp 16-inch OLED screen in a laptop that weighs only 3.37 lb. Inside are an Intel Core Ultra 7, 16GB of memory and a 1TB SSD, and PCWorld measured about 17.5 hours of battery life.
It sits right at the $1,000 line. PCWorld's price check showed it just under $1,000 at Best Buy while other stores charged more, so compare before you buy.
pros: Good battery life for a 16-inch laptop
products.best_for: Students and office workers who want a big screen without a heavy bag.
products.skip_if: you want the lowest price: the Amazon listing has been well above $1,000.
products.desc: A 16-inch Windows laptop with a 2880×1800 OLED screen, an Intel Core Ultra 7 256V chip, 16GB of RAM and a 1TB SSD. It weighs 3.37 lb and does not have standout AI features.
products.benefit: Picture a day split between lectures and an office desk, with a big, sharp screen and no heavy bag. PCWorld measured about 17.5 hours of battery, the longest of the PCWorld-tested picks in this guide, and it has Wi-Fi 7 and two Thunderbolt 4 ports. The catch: its AI features still feel unfinished, and PCWorld found it just under budget at one store while others charged more.

products.name: Acer Nitro V 16 AI
why: PCWorld's best budget gaming laptop was reviewed at $899 and has often been found much cheaper on sale. Its RTX 5050 graphics averaged around 72 fps in Cyberpunk 2077, which makes it a solid 1080p gaming machine for the money.
Battery life is unusually good for a gaming laptop (8 to 12 hours with light use). The weak spots are the processor, the speakers and the older Wi-Fi 6.
cons: Prices vary a lot between stores
products.best_for: Budget 1080p gaming that doubles as a school or work laptop.
products.skip_if: the Amazon price is above $1,000: PCWorld saw it far higher there than at other stores.
products.amazon_listing: Acer Nitro V 16 AI Gaming Laptop 16" WUXGA IPS 180Hz AMD 6-core Ryzen 5 240 16GB DDR5 512G
products.desc: A 16-inch gaming laptop with an AMD Ryzen 5 240, an Nvidia RTX 5050, 16GB of RAM and a 1920×1200 180Hz screen. It weighs 5.38 lb and has Wi-Fi 6 only.
products.benefit: Picture a student who games at 1080p in the evening and uses the same laptop for school during the day. Its RTX 5050 averaged around 72 fps in Cyberpunk 2077, and battery life is unusually good for a gaming laptop at 8 to 12 hours with light use. It is the only pick in this guide with dedicated graphics named in our sources. The catch: the CPU is sub-par, the speakers are poor, and prices vary a lot between stores.

products.name: Asus Chromebook Plus CX34
why: If your work lives in the browser, this Chromebook Plus is fast and simple. A Core i5 chip and 8GB of RAM keep everyday tasks smooth, the 14-inch 1080p touchscreen looks sharp and the keyboard is a highlight.
It costs roughly half of what most laptops on this list do. You do need to be happy with ChromeOS, and its battery life is only about average.
products.best_for: Web-based work, school and video calls on a tight budget.
products.skip_if: you need Windows or macOS desktop software.
products.amazon_listing: Asus Chromebook Plus CX34 CX3402CBA-DH388-GR 14" Chromebook - Full HD - Intel Core i3 12th
products.desc: A 14-inch Chromebook Plus with an Intel Core i5-1335U, 8GB of RAM and a 1920×1080 touchscreen. It runs ChromeOS only.
products.benefit: Picture a student who lives in the browser and Google apps, typing notes on a keyboard that PCWorld calls a highlight. It is fast for a Chromebook and costs roughly half of what most laptops on this list do. The catch: it runs ChromeOS only, and its battery life of about 13 hours is not class-leading.

products.name: Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3x
why: The IdeaPad Slim 3x runs on a Qualcomm Snapdragon X chip, which is why it can last all day on a charge at such a low price. It is one of the cheapest Copilot+ PCs you can buy, and reviewers describe it as a simple everyday laptop for browsing, streaming and notes.

PCWorld praises its battery life and day-to-day speed but warns that the hardware makes a lot of compromises. The 15-inch screen is the weakest part, and the body is aluminum on top with plastic underneath. At this price, those trade-offs are easier to accept.
specs: Qualcomm Snapdragon X chip with 45 TOPS NPU (Copilot+ PC)
Up to 14 hours of battery, Rapid Charge gives about 2 hours from a 15-minute charge, per Lenovo
Configurations vary, so check RAM and storage on the exact listing
pros: Very long battery life for the price
Big 15-inch screen with a number pad
cons: The screen is the weakest part
ARM chip, so check that your apps support Windows on ARM
products.best_for: Everyday browsing, schoolwork and office tasks on a tight budget.
products.skip_if: you need gaming, color-accurate photo work, or specialized Windows software.
products.amazon_listing: Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3X - 2025 - Everyday AI Laptop - Copilot+ PC - 15.3" WUXGA Display - 1
products.desc: A 15.3-inch Windows laptop with a Qualcomm Snapdragon X chip and a 45 TOPS NPU. It has an ARM chip, so some apps may not run.
products.benefit: Picture a laptop for browsing, streaming and notes that gets through a day without a charger. Lenovo claims up to 14 hours, and Rapid Charge gives about 2 hours from a 15-minute charge, per Lenovo. It is one of the cheapest Copilot+ PCs you can buy. The catch: PCWorld says the 15-inch screen is the weakest part and the hardware makes a lot of compromises.

products.name: Acer Aspire Go 15
why: PCWorld highlights the Aspire Go 15 for great battery life and a solid 1080p screen under $500, and BestReviews picks it as a sub-$500 laptop still worth using.
8bittoast says it is the most consistently recommended budget laptop under $500 in 2026.
cons: Integrated graphics only, so not for gaming
products.best_for: Students and home users who want a regular Windows laptop
products.skip_if: You need discrete graphics or a premium display
products.amazon_listing: Acer Aspire Go 15 AI Ready Laptop | 15.6" FHD IPS Display | AMD Ryzen 3 30 Processor | AMD
products.desc: A 15-inch Windows laptop with a 1080p display. It has integrated graphics only.
products.benefit: Picture a family laptop for homework, email and video calls. PCWorld highlights the Aspire Go 15 for great battery life and a solid 1080p screen, BestReviews picks it as a budget laptop still worth using, and 8bittoast calls it the most consistently recommended budget laptop in its range in 2026. The catch: integrated graphics only, so it is not for gaming.

products.name: ASUS Chromebook CX15
why: PCWorld names the CX15 the best Chromebook under $200, and Tom's Guide calls it one of the cheapest laptops it has tested that still does not disappoint.
Tom's Guide tested its battery life at 7 hours 26 minutes.
cons: Battery life is shorter than pricier picks
products.best_for: Anyone on a tight budget who needs a simple laptop
products.skip_if: You want long battery life or a premium feel
products.amazon_listing: ASUS Chromebook CX15 Laptop, 15.6" FHD Anti-Glare Display, Intel® Processor N50, 128GB Sto
products.desc: A 15-inch Chromebook with a tested battery life of 7 hours 26 minutes (Tom's Guide). It is a basic machine, not a premium one.
products.benefit: Picture a simple laptop for web pages, documents and video calls. PCWorld names it the best Chromebook in its low-price class, and Tom's Guide calls it one of the cheapest laptops it has tested that still does not disappoint. It is the cheapest pick in this guide. The catch: its 7 hours 26 minutes of tested battery is the shortest figure in this guide.

products.name: Acer Aspire 5
why: PCGuide recommends the Acer Aspire 5 Slim for anyone shopping around $600 for non-gaming use. Impressive Magazine names the 2026 Aspire 5 its best Windows all-rounder.
RTINGS, as cited by iTechGuides, lists the related Acer Aspire 15 as an alternative to its top pick.
specs: Suited to office work, browsing and light streaming (PCGuide)
pros: Good for study and office work
products.best_for: Students and families who want a dependable Windows laptop
products.skip_if: You want to play demanding games
products.amazon_listing: acer Aspire 5 Touchscreen Laptop, 15.6" Full HD, 13th Gen Core i5-13420H (8-Core), 8GB RAM
products.desc: A Windows 11 laptop for office work, browsing and light streaming (PCGuide). It is not made for gaming.
products.benefit: Picture a student writing papers, browsing and watching lectures on a dependable Windows laptop. PCGuide recommends the Aspire 5 Slim for non-gaming use, and Impressive Magazine names the 2026 Aspire 5 its best Windows all-rounder. It is the plain all-round Windows choice among this guide's mid-budget picks. The catch: it is not made for gaming.

products.name: ASUS Vivobook 16 (M1605)
why: iTechGuides reports that RTINGS names the Vivobook 16 M1605 its best tested laptop under $600, and says it is the strongest overall Windows pick when the configuration has at least 16GB of RAM and a 512GB SSD.
Impressive Magazine also praises the 2026 ASUS Vivobook 15 as the best display for the price, so the Vivobook family shows up across sources.
pros: Top RTINGS pick in this price range
cons: Only worth buying in the 16GB / 512GB configuration
products.best_for: People who want the best-tested Windows laptop under $600
products.skip_if: You want a small, light laptop to carry all day
products.amazon_listing: ASUS Vivobook 16 Laptop, 16” WUXGA 60Hz Display, Qualcomm Snapdragon X, Qualcomm Adreno GP
products.desc: A 16-inch Windows laptop. iTechGuides says to look for the 16GB RAM and 512GB SSD configuration.
products.benefit: Picture a student who wants a large screen for documents and spreadsheets and is willing to carry a bigger laptop. iTechGuides reports that RTINGS names it its best tested laptop in this price range, strongest overall when it has at least 16GB of RAM and a 512GB SSD. The catch: it is only worth buying in that configuration, and the 16-inch size is less portable.

products.name: Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3
why: iTechGuides lists a properly configured Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 among the best $600 laptops, and Impressive Magazine includes the 2026 IdeaPad 3i. Fypower calls the IdeaPad Slim 3i 15.6 its best-value pick.
Fypower says Lenovo puts these laptops through 12 military-grade durability tests and that the 15.6-inch model weighs 3.42 pounds.
cons: Pick the configuration carefully: 4GB or 128GB models are weak for daily use (iTechGuides)
products.best_for: Budget buyers who want a sturdy everyday laptop
products.skip_if: You want a premium screen or strong graphics

products.desc: A 15.6-inch Windows 11 laptop that weighs 3.42 lb (Fypower). Weak 4GB or 128GB versions exist.
products.benefit: Picture a sturdy everyday laptop for schoolwork that goes in a backpack every day. Fypower calls the Slim 3i 15.6 its best-value pick and says Lenovo puts these laptops through 12 military-grade durability tests. It is light for a 15.6-inch laptop. The catch: pick the configuration carefully, because 4GB or 128GB models are weak for daily use.

products.name: MacBook Neo
why: MacBook Neo is the best budget laptop according to CNET and TechRadar.
products.desc: MacBook Neo is a 13‑inch laptop with an A18 Pro chip, a premium MacBook look, stereo speakers and Touch ID. It has a 256GB SSD baseline and no MagSafe or fast charging.
products.benefit: Picture a student who wants a Mac experience without the high price. MacBook Neo gives a powerful A18 Pro chip and good sound for a lower cost. It wins against the Dell XPS 13 by being cheaper and still powerful, but it has a smaller battery and shorter battery life. The catch: it lacks a headphone jack and a larger SSD.

products.name: Dell XPS 13 (2026)
why: Dell XPS 13 is highlighted as the best Windows laptop for students by CNET.
products.desc: Dell XPS 13 (2026) is a thin, light, all‑metal laptop with a 13.4‑inch high‑res display, quad speakers, two 10Gbps USB‑C ports and Wi‑Fi 7 networking.
products.benefit: Picture a student who needs a lightweight, high‑resolution screen for note‑taking. Dell XPS 13 offers a roomy display and full sound, making it great for studying. It outperforms the MacBook Neo in display size and audio, but it has a budget‑feel touchpad and no headphone jack. The catch: it lacks a headphone jack.

products.name: MacBook Air M5
why: MacBook Air M5 is listed as the best Mac by CNET.
products.desc: MacBook Air M5 is a thin, light, rigid aluminum laptop with a 512GB minimum SSD, improved app and graphics performance from the M5 chip.
products.benefit: Picture a creative professional who wants a lightweight Mac with strong performance. MacBook Air M5 delivers better graphics and AI performance than its predecessor, and its slim design is easy to carry. It beats the Dell XPS 13 in performance but has a higher price. The catch: it costs $500 more than the MacBook Neo.
products.amazon_listing: Apple 2026 MacBook Air 13-inch Laptop with M5 chip: Built for AI, 13.6-inch Liquid Retina

intro: The same laptop can cost very different amounts at different stores. PCWorld saw the Acer Nitro V 16 AI far higher on Amazon than at other stores, and the Swift 16 AI just under the budget line at Best Buy while other stores charged more.
Some of these only drop into budget at certain stores or during sales, so compare before you buy.

verdict.line: If you want one laptop on a budget, get this one: it is PCWorld's pick for best budget laptop, with a sturdy aluminum body, a sharp 13-inch screen and about 13 hours of battery. It has only 8GB of memory and its multi-core performance lags.

tips.title: 4 mistakes when buying a budget laptop
items: Paying the first price you see.
PCWorld saw the Nitro V 16 AI far higher on Amazon than at other stores, and the Swift 16 AI just under the budget line at only one store.
iTechGuides warns that 4GB or 128GB models of the IdeaPad Slim 3 are weak for daily use. For the Vivobook 16, look for 16GB of RAM and a 512GB SSD.
Forgetting that a Chromebook runs ChromeOS only.
The Chromebook picks cannot install Windows or macOS desktop software, so check your classes or work first.
The IdeaPad Slim 3x has an ARM chip, so check that your apps support Windows on ARM.

faq: What is the best budget laptop for most people?
The Apple MacBook Neo. It is PCWorld's pick for best budget laptop, with about 13 hours of battery at 2.7 lb. Its multi-core performance lags.
What is the best gaming laptop on a budget?
The Acer Nitro V 16 AI. Its RTX 5050 averaged around 72 fps in Cyberpunk 2077 in PCWorld's review. The CPU, speakers and Wi-Fi 6 are weak spots.
Which Windows laptop has the best battery life?
The Acer Swift 16 AI. PCWorld measured about 17.5 hours. The IdeaPad Slim 3x claims up to 14 hours, according to Lenovo.
Is a Chromebook enough for school?
If your work lives in the browser, yes. The Asus Chromebook Plus CX34 is our Best Chromebook. Skip it if you need Windows or macOS desktop software.
The ASUS Chromebook CX15. PCWorld names it the best Chromebook in its low-price class. Tom's Guide tested its battery at 7 hours 26 minutes.
